🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL; Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Mixed signals: narrow sector wins (Energy, Industrials) offset by broad Tech weakness and several large-cap divergences, supporting a neutral stance.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leading: OXY (1W: +13.81% | 1M: +21.51%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +1.56% | 1M: +13.56%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare showing pockets of strength: SYK (1W: +5.10% | 1M: +7.27%) ABOVE TREND and JNJ (1W: +0.98% | 1M: +12.52%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology weak: ADBE (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -17.70%) BELOW TREND and MSFT (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -14.58%) BELOW TREND. Financials and Consumer Discretionary also lag: JPM (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -1.96%) BELOW TREND and TSLA (1W: -4.22% | 1M: -11.02%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: OXY (1W: +13.81% | 1M: +21.51%) ABOVE TREND, PYPL (1W: +9.33% | 1M: -22.92%) RECOVERY, GE (1W: +7.48% | 1M: +14.91%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +23.83%) ABOVE TREND, ASML (1W: +5.64% | 1M: +6.66%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5), indicating dispersion rather than single-sector dominance.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ADBE (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -17.70%) BELOW TREND, DOW (1W: -6.74% | 1M: +6.95%) CORRECTION, INTC (1W: -6.75% | 1M: -19.68%) BELOW TREND, ETN (1W: -6.99% | 1M: +8.39%) CORRECTION, COF (1W: -8.03% | 1M: -18.86%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select Tech and Financial names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: OXY (1W: +13.81% | 1M: +21.51%) ABOVE TREND, PYPL (1W: +9.33% | 1M: -22.92%) RECOVERY, GE (1W: +7.48% | 1M: +14.91%) ABOVE TREND; note major divergence in PYPL (bullish news-driven 1W move vs 1M weakness), flag as tactical momentum rather than broad confirmation.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech showing internal dispersion and overall weakness (1W: -2.81%); NVDA (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +3.63%) ABOVE TREND and ASML (1W: +5.64% | 1M: +6.66%) ABOVE TREND contrast with ADBE (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -17.70%) BELOW TREND and MSFT (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -14.58%) BELOW TREND.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials broadly soft (1W: -1.56%); pockets of strength in standouts like PYPL RECOVERY (1W: +9.33% | 1M: -22.92%) but core names lag with JPM (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -1.96%) BELOW TREND and V (1W: -2.41% | 1M: -5.89%) BELOW TREND.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare mixed but modestly positive (1W: +0.41%); leaders JNJ (1W: +0.98% | 1M: +12.52%) ABOVE TREND and SYK (1W: +5.10% | 1M: +7.27%) ABOVE TREND offset UNH (1W: -3.70% | 1M: -20.35%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: +1.78% | 1M: -2.49%) RECOVERY.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Energy and Industrials exposure (OXY, DE, GE) where trend confirmation exists and reduce exposure to large-cap Tech names showing persistent BELOW TREND readings. Given NEUTRAL regime and major divergences, emphasize stock selection and short-term momentum rather than broad style bets.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMAT (1W: +5.38% | 1M: +17.32%) ABOVE TREND, ASML (1W: +5.64% | 1M: +6.66%) ABOVE TREND, PYPL (1W: +9.33% | 1M: -22.92%) RECOVERY — all have news or momentum catalysts. BEARISH: IBM (1W: -14.88% | 1M: -23.77%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -3.70% | 1M: -20.35%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -6.75% | 1M: -19.68%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (positive 1W performance) and Industrials (pockets of ABOVE TREND names). BEARISH: Technology and Financials given broad 1W weakness and multiple large-cap BELOW TREND names.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +3.63%) ABOVE TREND for continuation above recent weekly highs to confirm tech momentum; AAPL (1W: +4.07% | 1M: +7.28%) ABOVE TREND holding its 1M gains would validate broad risk appetite; MSFT (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -14.58%) BELOW TREND breaking near-term support would deepen Tech weakness.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
PYPL (+80): takeover interest headline; PYPL (1W: +9.33% | 1M: -22.92%) RECOVERY — short-term news confirmed 1W strength but 1M weakness signals distribution risk. AMAT (+60): expects strong semiconductor growth; AMAT (1W: +5.38% | 1M: +17.32%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirms price strength. WMT (+60): earnings beat and buyback; WMT (1W: -6.03% | 1M: +6.77%) CORRECTION — bullish news contrasts with 1W weakness, watch for follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
IBM (-60): AI threat headline; IBM (1W: -14.88% | 1M: -23.77%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price confirm deterioration. XOM (-60): legal/board risks; XOM (1W: +1.56% | 1M: +13.56%) ABOVE TREND — negative news diverges from price, monitor for sentiment-driven pullback. UNH (-50): lowered expectations; UNH (1W: -3.70% | 1M: -20.35%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirming downside risk.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. AAPL (1W: +4.07% | 1M: +7.28%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +3.63%) ABOVE TREND and OXY (1W: +13.81% | 1M: +21.51%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major large-cap Tech and Financial divergences and negative headlines on IBM (-60) and XOM (-60) create tactical volatility to monitor.
